narrator.name: Requirements Reuben
narrator.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I was tracing the promotion allocation workflow and noticed the automated acceptance criteria checks have stopped firing. The configuration file was altered during the last infrastructure migration, which left the validation pipeline dormant. Because the automated trigger is silent, the team now runs the validation steps manually before each release. Developers submit a pull request, and a reviewer opens the test environment to verify the allocation logic against the sample data sets. This manual verification happens every time a feature branch is merged into the main trunk. No alerts are generated in the build log when the criteria are not met, so the human check is the only step confirming that the code meets the defined standards before it is deployed to production.
output.reclassify_reason: The text objectively describes the current state of the workflow, the cause of the failure (configuration alteration), and the resulting manual process without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
